title: Why story hooks beat question hooks on LinkedIn

hero.label: median engagement, story hooks
hero.alt: Story hooks lead LinkedIn engagement at a 2.60% median, question hooks trail at 2.16%. Source: AuthoredUp analysis of 309,614 posts.

visuals.headline: Question hooks come last of five
visuals.source: Source: AuthoredUp, 309,614 personal-profile posts, Dec 2025 to May 2026
visuals.alt: Median LinkedIn engagement by hook: story 2.60%, contrarian 2.31%, statement 2.27%, results 2.19%, question 2.16%. Source: AuthoredUp.

visuals.after_heading: Why "always open with a question" is bad advice
visuals.text: A question works as a closer that invites a response, not as an opener that has to earn one.
visuals.source: Source: SocialSprint analysis of AuthoredUp data
visuals.alt: Key idea: a question works as a closer, not an opener.

visuals.after_heading: What a story hook looks like for a B2B seller

visuals.after_heading: Length and closing lines matter too
visuals.headline: Short first lines win
visuals.alt: LinkedIn hooks under 40 characters reach 2.61% median engagement against 2.08% for hooks over 200 characters. Source: AuthoredUp.
